Name: More Specific Gift Reaction - Dialogue Expansion (English Translation) - 1.6 Compatible
Author: uhfeldspar
Description:
[u][b]17/04/2024 - It took a while, but the mod has been updated for 1.6! Yippee!!![/b]
[/u]

It can get tedious seeing the same reactions to your gifts over and over, especially if you're trying to clear Qi's Kindness, which requires you to give loved gifts to villagers. While 1.6 did add some new gift reactions, they're still few and far in between the villagers.

With this mod, you'll get different reactions from all vanilla villagers depending on what you give them.

(This is a translated version of the same mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/142226403]Kaori_Haruta[/url], which you can find [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11368]here[/url]!)
[b][size=5]
About this mod (adapted from original mod link):[/size]
[/b]
This mod doesn't change any gift tastes. Rather, it simply alters their dialogue when given a specific gift. There are several categories of gift reactions, so feel free to explore each type. Each item will have about 1-2 lines.

[list]
[*][b]Loved gifts:[/b] Self-explanatory. They also have different reactions if you give these to them for their birthday.
[*][b]Hated gifts: [/b]Also self-explanatory.
[*][b]General gifts:[/b] This can range from receiving crops, forage and flowers. Feel free to explore! 
[*][b]Unique gifts:[/b] Some villagers have something to say about certain items (for example, try giving Leah hardwood, or a Pink Cake to Lewis). You might be able to learn some information about another person's gift tastes through them. Not all reactions will be positive, though!
[*][b]Recipe review:[/b] This triggers if you give a villager a dish that they taught you the recipe for (for example, Linus and Fish Taco). [b]Only plays the day after learning the recipe from them in the mail[/b].
[*][b]Returning Goods:[/b] Only triggers from shopkeepers (Sandy, Pierre, etc.) after giving them something that can be bought at their store.
[*][b]Golden Pumpkin:[/b] Optional, and self explanatory. Each villager has a unique dialogue on giving this to them.
[/list]
Not all gifts are covered, however - items like the Prismatic Shard and Rabbit's Foot will still generally illicit the generic gift reaction from most villagers, and some items may share the same reaction.

The mod was originally written to be faithful to the vanilla game as much as possible, and in turn, I did my best to adhere to it as well. If there's any part of it you want to change, you can edit the content file to suit your needs, such as if you have certain mods that change gift tastes!
[b]
Compatibility
[/b]
Unless it tampers directly with gift reactions, this shouldn't conflict with most dialogue mods. It also runs fine with most expansion mods (SVE, Ridgeside, East Scarpe), though due to potential map changes, you may wish to adjust some of the dialogue.

In the case of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21501]Unique Dialogue Expansion:[/url] Both mods do share dialogue for specific items (for example, Pink Cake for Haley), so there may be overlaps. But for the most part, they will both still work together as long as you keep this in mind.
